longTitle.officialTitle: To amend the Federal Water Pollution Control Act to reauthorize the Great Lakes Restoration Initiative, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Great Lakes Restoration Initiative Act of 2019” or the “GLRI Act of 2019”.

section.heading: GREAT LAKES RESTORATION INITIATIVE REAUTHORIZATION.
section.chapeau: Section 118(c)(7)(J)(i) of the Federal Water Pollution Control Act (33 U.S.C. 1268(c)(7)(J)(i)) is amended—

paragraph.content: by striking “is authorized” and inserting “are authorized”;
by striking the period at the end and inserting a semicolon;

by striking “this paragraph $300,000,000” and inserting the following:“this paragraph—
